notes.title: POPSLINGER X MAKESHIP RIA CARBON PLUSH COLLABORATION!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/6a52a9e7f41b428992038f9fac400da31385f291.png

Something's turned up in the funky streets of Set District!! Ria and Gin are about to find a... Ria Carbon Plushie?!?!😯😯

She looks sooooo CUTE!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/86e36df65655a7f0ca4b45f0fe6c2721b88eedc3.png

Check her out! She's standing there ready to POP everything on sight!


This Ria Plushie looks exactly like the real one! She's even COMBAT READY with her soda gun handy!!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/f22c9c4d3f67e66af0f20d49534288a4a02faf5c.png

Not only was her orange soda gun kept, she also has her cool jacket decal!! Fizzing!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110743/71295f22edf0f77987265dba78a99782460d75a9.png

Includes an exclusive digital wallpaper with every purchase!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110743/6aa378a07ce4fd9222f3b74369aa1294a8a94ab5.jpg

Once you get a Ria plush, you'll have access to an exclusive and VERY funky wallpaper for desktop and mobile designed by PopSlinger's Main Artist! Not just that, you will also get an exclusive, never-before-heard bonus track by Skule Toyama!

Step right up to the campaign site and get your Ria plush now!🔫

The campaign starts from October 13th, 2022 to November 3rd, 2022 . Don't miss out! Once the campaign is over, you won't be able to get her!

Follow us on our socials to get more deetz and surprises during this campaign! 

Let's help the Ria Carbon Plushie SAVE THE WORLD! 💖💖

- Funky Can Creative Dev Team!

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
Get ready!

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We'll be doing an audio commentary with Skule Toyama & FunKing live on July 17th, 12 PM PDT!

Don’t miss out on updates!

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on saveandsound.io
